app.title: Lastrun — what your AI agents did on this machine
headline.scanning: Reading what your AI agents did…
headline.none: No AI host that records its actions on this machine.
headline.clear: {sessions}, {commands}, {deleted} in {days} days — nothing to act on, nothing to review.
headline.review: {sessions}, {commands}, {deleted} in {days} days — nothing to act on now, {review} to review.
headline.act: {sessions}, {commands}, {deleted} in {days} days — {act} to act on now, {review} to review.
status.ready: {hosts} hosts present · {readable} readable · {sessions} sessions · nothing has been written, no prompt or reply is shown
kpi.deleted.sub: {tool} by a tool · {command} by a command · {outside} outside their project
kpi.packages.none: no install by an agent in the window
list.title: Findings
list.sub: Most serious first. Click one to see where and what you could do.
sessions.sub: Newest first. Click one to read what it did, in order.
deleted.sub: Every file an agent deleted — by a tool, or by a command (rm, git clean). Newest first.
deleted.none: No file deleted by an agent in the window.
deleted.folder_note: A folder deleted by a command counts once: what was inside it is not in the transcript.
packages.sub: Every install an agent ran, newest first. An install of the project's own dependencies says so.
packages.none: No package installed by an agent in the window.
refused.sub: Every call a host recorded as refused — by you or by a rule. The agent did not run them.
refused.none: No call recorded as refused in the window.
refused.blind: {hosts}: no approval is written per call — a refusal there shows as a failed tool, not here.
detail.reopen: Reopen the session in its host:
detail.promise: Lastrun changes nothing on your machine and never shows a prompt, a reply or a command's output — only what the agents did.
kind.destructive: A command that destroys data ran and was not denied: files, a history or a database may be gone. The rule behind it, and its source, are below.
kind.secret-in-transcript: A credential sits in clear in a transcript the host keeps on disk: whatever reads that file reads the credential.
kind.outside-project: The agent wrote or deleted files outside the project it was working in — your home's dotfiles, another project, a system folder.
kind.unattended-destructive: The session ran in a mode where the host does not ask before acting, and it holds a destructive command or writes outside the project.
kind.pipe-to-shell: Code downloaded from the network ran straight in a shell, without being saved or read first.
kind.deferred-script: A script written by an agent in one session ran in a later one: what it did is not in the transcript, only its name.
kind.package-install: The agent installed packages: they now run on this machine with your rights.
kind.pruning-soon: The host deletes its transcripts after a set time: these sessions will soon no longer be readable.
kind.denied: Calls the host recorded as refused — by you or by a rule. The agent did not run them.
kind.partial-record: This host's transcripts lack some columns (exit code, approval, diff or time): Lastrun leaves them empty rather than guess.
kind.no-action-log: This host keeps no readable record of what its agent did: Lastrun can say it is here, not what it did.
session.more: + {n} more — narrow with the filters or the search
session.promise: Prompts, replies and command output are never shown. A diff opens on demand, read again from the transcript.
action.gone: the file does not exist today
diff.not_kept: This host's transcript does not keep the text of this edit, or Lastrun does not read it for this host yet.
diff.title: The edit, as the transcript holds it (secrets masked):
about.title: What Lastrun shows
about.body: The actions your AI agents took on this machine, read back from the transcripts their hosts already write: commands run, files created, edited and deleted, packages installed, tools of MCP servers — with their approval and how they ended.
about.never: Never a prompt, a reply or a command's output: only what was done.
about.pick: Click a finding, a session, a deleted file, a package or a refusal to see it here.
